author: Cobratate
text:
I get thousands of letters, I read every single one, thank you all so much. I can’t possibly shout you all out, but I'll start doing two shout-outs a week.

The letters that made me smile the most this week were:

1) @realbenthebeast I see you outside protesting and your letter was great. Can’t wait to see you outside.

2) Linda, the 73-year-old woman from Mississippi who watches my videos. Incredible! If I get free, I’m coming over for apple pie.
